overview.title: Course Details
overview.content: The Kids অনর্গল English Course is Chalak Champs' most popular Online Live Spoken English Program, specially built for children who are starting from absolute zero. This isn't just an English class. It builds fluent speaking, correct pronunciation, Basic Grammar, Accent Training, and confidence to present, perform, and communicate in any situation.

items.q: My child has zero English knowledge, can they still join?
items.a: Absolutely yes. This course is built to start from zero, no prior English knowledge needed at all.

items.q: What is difference between Level 1 and Level 2?
items.a: Level 1 (Class 1–4) focuses on Basic Phonetics and Basic Spoken. Level 2 (Class 5–8) covers Advanced Phonetics, Spoken, Accent Training, and Basic Grammar together.
Yes, this is a fully Online Live Batch. Your child attends live classes from home, comfortably and safely.

items.q: Do installment students get all same benefits?
items.a: Yes, both payment options include all the same benefits. The only difference is the total fee amount.

items.q: Will my child receive a certificate after completion?
items.a: Yes, every student who successfully completes the course receives an official Chalak Champs Certificate.

items.q: What if my child misses a class?
items.a: Call us at 01740176774, our team will find the best solution for your child.
